name: Specify from the Code
description: Spares people retyping what the code already declares, while leaving to them the text only a person can write.
purpose: Keep the records of a solution and its alternatives in step with the code that declares them, and create a new solution in one command.
approach: Read the declarations in the code and write only the missing rows with what the code knows, leaving a person's text untouched.
out_of_scope: Writing the intent itself, and importing the code it reads.
milestones: 1. Declaration sync: every declared solution or alternative missing from the records is reported, a second sync writes nothing, and a person's text survives. [met: 2026-10-26]
knowledge: Decorator registries and plugin systems; schema derivation from code; the author's earlier pipeline decorators, which declare a stage once.
measures_of_success: A declared solution or alternative that the records lack is reported, the rows written are complete in what the code knows and empty in what only a person knows, and a second sync writes nothing. Standing conditions: What the code declares is in the records without retyping; the missing rows are written with only what the code knows; a new solution is one command; no cell a person wrote is overwritten.
parameters: The intent folder to write into; the id of a new solution.
inputs: The source files of the measured code and the intent records.
outputs: Findings (rule S30), the rows written, and for a new solution the records, a code skeleton and an evaluation folder.
effects: Writes record rows and, for a new solution, a module and an evaluation folder; never overwrites a cell that has text.
usage_notes: Run `esoi records sync` after declaring an alternative and `esoi new solution <id>` to start one, then write the text only you can.
change_driver: the system's own data model or code
